# PrincipalRef

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from `schemas/policy/v1.json`. Do not edit by hand. -->

A user or group (#38). Each is an object with one key, the kind.

Appears at: `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/principals/exclude`, `/policy/rule_set_scopes/scopes/principals/include`, `/policy/scope/principals/exclude`, `/policy/scope/principals/include`, `/policy/unknown/scope_groups/all_of/principals/exclude`, `/policy/unknown/scope_groups/all_of/principals/include`, and more.

## Variants

### `user_pattern`

A wildcard on the `DOMAIN\user` account name, such as `*\svc_*`.
Names can be spoofed, so a pattern may only narrow a rule that lets
an object run, and only widen a deny (validation).

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Constraints | Since | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user_pattern` | string | yes |  |  | 1.0.0 |  |
